questions.answer: Keyword research is still foundational to SEO, but the approach has shifted toward user intent and conversational queries rather than exact-match terms [4]. Joe recommends identifying the specific problems your audience wants to solve, using intent-classification tools that look at search volume patterns, SERP features, related keyword clusters, and seasonal shifts [3][4]. Keyword research should also cover how your audience searches on other platforms, such as Reddit or TikTok, and include competitor analysis to find content gaps [4].
